remarks: Situated in a highly walkable corridor just south of Main Street in Clarence, this 3.16-acre parcel on the west side of Ransom Road offers a unique wooded setting that is naturally enclosed and difficult to find at this scale. The site provides genuine privacy with a meaningful setback opportunity for a new home surrounded by mature tree cover. The southern boundary borders the Clarence Pathways, a 20-mile paved multi-use trail for walking, jogging, and cycling. Running elevated along the tree line, it adds a desirable community amenity without impacting the privacy of the parcel. Shops, restaurants, everyday conveniences, and Clarence Central Schools are all accessible from Main Street's well-developed sidewalk corridor. Clarence Hollow, celebrated for its antiques, local dining, and community character, is just down the road. NY-5 and Transit Road provide easy regional access. Currently zoned Residential Single-Family, this well-positioned lot is ready for development, offering tree cover, privacy, and a direct connection to the community that defines this part of Clarence. Lot dimensions based on survey. There is also a 1.5 car garage on the property - 20 x 20.
